examples.text: This all relates to what happened in the 1990s, in the bloody aftermath of Yugoslavia splintering into separate nations.
examples.ref: 2015 February 3, Greg Botelho, “U.N. court: Serbs’ actions in Croatia not considered genocide”, in CNN, archived from the original on 16 Aug 2025:

examples.text: Yugoslavia’s President, Slobodan Milosevic, has rejected all efforts at meaningful diplomacy and, in violation of his own previous commitments, has ratcheted up his military campaign against the innocent civilians of Kosovo.
